title: A pocket inventory
summary: Print a bounded Markdown inventory of a folder without reading file contents or following symlinks.
epitaph: Took only names. Left only a list.
revive_when: A project is too bulky to keep, but you want to remember its structure.

related.reason: An inventory supplies the 'what exists' section of a project eulogy.

origin: Original, dependency-free starter utility written for graveyard.
